title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode11 KAITO's Hint

rows.Line: bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh no... No, no, no! Not this again!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Huh... Where are we?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Were we teleported or something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, take us back right now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh my! There are so many of you today☆ Yay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's Miku! Mikuuu! We came to say hi!

rows.Speaker: Rui & Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome to SEKAI☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Tsukasa and Emu.
I'm glad to see you've brought friends along this time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hello, KAITO! We'll be doing shows together, the four of us!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
That's Hatsune Miku... And KAITO?
They don't look like holograms...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Rui, what is this? Please say something... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on the hyperrealistic presentation of the VIRTUAL SINGERS, it is highly probable that this is a virtual world. Yet, I do not detect any changes to my own body.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In which case, it would seem that they possess real bodies much like my own, meaning it's not a digital world, but an analog world where they too are real.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If this world has such properties as to make the imaginary real, it could be an unparalleled source of inspiration! I must research it thoroughly! Mwahaha!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Rui? Where do you think you're going?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Once he gets like this, there's no stopping him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's good to see you again.
Have you remembered your true feelings?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I already told you, the only thing I want is to become the world's top star!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've come to see you today because Tsukasa is stumped and needs some hints for his performance!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-I'm not stumped!
I just haven't quite got in character yet, that's all...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you mind showing me the script?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... Tsukasa is playing the prince.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! A courageous and wise prince among princes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's an awe-inspiring character, isn't it?
I wonder how I'd play him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know! Maybe I could try playing the prince.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You'll do that for us? Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, there. Aren't you going to join the others?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you. I'm Miku♪
That robot is so cute. Are you the one controlling it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry! Did I startle you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No... I wasn't...startled. I... I just...don't like being seen...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm?
Ah. You don't like talking face-to-face?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Do not be embarrassed.
We can talk later if you feel ready♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Why do I find it so hard to talk to people?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
“I take it upon myself to slay the demon lord!”
How about this kind of delivery?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Ooh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You spoke and fought like a real prince!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh. Not... Not too shabby!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You've pointed me in the right direction at least!
I now know how to improve my rendition of the prince even more!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're good to go now. Let's head back and practice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Guys, this world is incredible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are, Rui.
I got some new ideas for my role, so we were about to head ba—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you won't believe this! I've captured a bizarre creature made of cotton. What's more, it can talk!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Sob... Tsukasa, save me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yikes! It's that creepy bunny again!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'd like to take it home and run some experiments.
I wonder what it looks like on the inside?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: I-I'm scared...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Forget it! Just leave it here, and let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But... I went through all that trouble catching it...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Don't you have enough weird stuff piled up at your place?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What she said! Just stick with robots, okay? We're leaving!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Already? But I wanted us to do a show together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I refuse! I cannot afford any more distractions from my path to stardom!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... And what will you do once you become a star?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What do you mean?
I'll perform in lots of shows, and people will crowd to see me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But if you perform here, maybe you'll discover something. Something wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh yeah? Like what?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's a secret☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha! You're only saying that because you think it will convince me to join your shows!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's a pity you don't want to stay, but that's your choice. If there's anything else you need help with, you're welcome to visit us anytime.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And of course, our offer to perform together still stands. Maybe you'll change your mind one day, and then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And then what? Ah, never mind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, are you okay? You look sad.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You can tell by looking at this metal face?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't know why, but you just FEEL sad to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Enough talking, we've got work to do!
